articles.title: El Burdeos acuerda su venta a Park Bench por un euro
articles.standfirst: La cifra simbólica, que incluye la obligación de asumir la mitad de la deuda, supone un paso clave para evitar la liquidación del histórico club francés
articles.summary: La cifra simbólica, que incluye la obligación de asumir la mitad de la deuda, supone un paso clave para evitar la liquidación
articles.body: El Girondins de Burdeos anunció este miércoles la firma de un acuerdo de cesión entre la sociedad de Gérard Lopez, propietario de la entidad desde 2021, y el fondo de inversión británico Park Bench. La operación se ha cerrado por el precio simbólico de un euro e incluye la asunción de la deuda del club por parte de los nuevos inversores. La venta deberá superar ahora los controles reglamentarios de la Comisión Regional de Control de Gestión de la Liga de Fútbol de Nueva Aquitania, que examinará en los próximos días la solvencia del proyecto y el presupuesto para la temporada 2026-27, según indican desde el club en un comunicado oficial. El acuerdo pone fin a varios meses de incertidumbre sobre el futuro de una de las entidades históricas del fútbol francés. La operación se acompaña de una profunda reestructuración financiera que ha resultado determinante para desbloquear la venta, según L'Equipe. La deuda incluida en el plan de continuidad del club pasará de unos 26 millones de euros a aproximadamente 13 millones, mientras que el calendario de devolución se ampliará de diez a doce años. Además, Gérard López renuncia a los créditos que mantenía frente al club y a cualquier derecho a recuperar esas cantidades en caso de que la entidad mejore su situación financiera en el futuro. La situación del Burdeos se había deteriorado gravemente durante los últimos años. Cuando López tomó el control de la entidad en 2021, el equipo todavía competía en la Ligue 1. Desde entonces encadenó descensos deportivos y problemas económicos que le llevaron a perder progresivamente su estatus en el fútbol profesional francés. Este verano, después de que la Dirección Nacional de Control de Gestión (DNCG) y posteriormente la Federación Francesa ratificaran las sanciones impuestas por incumplimientos financieros, el club fue relegado a la categoría Regional 1, equivalente al sexto nivel del fútbol francés. La amenaza de una liquidación judicial se convirtió en una posibilidad real durante las últimas semanas. El tribunal de comercio de Burdeos había fijado una fecha límite para que los propietarios presentaran una solución viable que garantizara la continuidad de la entidad. Las negociaciones con Park Bench atravesaron varias fases de bloqueo e incluso llegaron a darse por rotas a comienzos de septiembre, antes de reactivarse tras la renegociación de buena parte de las obligaciones financieras del club, indicaban medios locales. La reducción de la deuda ha sido uno de los elementos decisivos para la entrada del nuevo inversor. Diversos medios franceses señalaron que el acuerdo contempla quitas sobre créditos públicos vinculados al IVA y a la seguridad social francesa, además de una rebaja de otras obligaciones pendientes. También se alcanzó un pacto con el exentrenador Vladimir Petkovic para cerrar un litigio laboral que suponía uno de los principales riesgos económicos para la entidad. Aunque la venta ya ha sido firmada, todavía quedan varios pasos administrativos antes de que el cambio de propiedad sea definitivo. El tribunal de comercio deberá homologar el nuevo plan de continuidad y los organismos de control de la liga regional tendrán que validar tanto la entrada de Park Bench como la viabilidad financiera del proyecto deportivo. Si supera esos trámites, el histórico club bordelés podrá iniciar una nueva etapa con el objetivo de estabilizar sus cuentas y comenzar el camino de regreso hacia las categorías nacionales del fútbol francés. El comprador es el fondo de inversión británico Park Bench, una firma vinculada al empresario James Bord que ya cuenta con presencia en el fútbol español a través de su participación accionarial en el Córdoba. La adquisición del Burdeos encaja en una estrategia centrada en entidades deportivas con potencial de recuperación patrimonial y deportiva. Los nuevos propietarios asumen ahora el reto de reflotar a uno de los clubes más laureados de Francia, hundido por los problemas financieros y los sucesivos descensos que le han llevado hasta la Regional 1, la sexta categoría del fútbol francés.

articles.body: Yuki Kurihara, the 11-year-old child prodigy from Japan, won a Gold medal in the Asian Games on Saturday, beating a series of opponents up to three times his age.While today, most 11-year-olds are thinking about homework, snacks and the next level of their favourite game. Yuki Kurihara is thinking about gold medals too.Ask any child what they want to be when they grow up, and the answers usually come quickly: an astronaut, a footballer, a YouTuber. Very few say "a champion," and even fewer become one before finishing primary school. Yuki Kurihara beat the odds, calling the Gold medal 'beautiful, shiny and heavy ’.Meet Yuki Kurihara: The 11-year-old eel-loving boy who won Asian Games gold with a puzzle gameEleven-year-old Yuki Kurihara, who studies in primary school and loves eating eel, won an Asian Games gold medal in Japan on Saturday. He is believed to be the youngest competitor at the Games in Aichi-Nagoya and won the esports game Puyo Puyo Champions 10-2 in the final, after starting the match 1-0 down, according to an AFP report.Despite the big win, he stayed calm. The boy, who prepares for contests by eating eel, had just beaten a string of opponents, some of them three times his age. He said, "To be completely honest, I felt a bit embarrassed, so I couldn't really show my expressions or change my face much."He was delighted with his medal. "I'm really happy. The gold medal is really beautiful, shiny and heavy," he said. He had earlier bowed slightly as he received it and given a small wave.What is the game Puyo Puyo about?According to The Japan Times report, in the game players try to clear their screen of coloured blobs by lining them up and popping them. He won the final with a massive score of 10-2, even though he was down 1-0 at the start of the final before he pulled away.Young, but not the oldest storyKurihara is believed to be the youngest competitor at the Games in Aichi-Nagoya, and his journey with the sport began only on a small scale when he received Puyo Puyo Tetris 2 as a Christmas present five years ago and became fascinated by how the game's chains work. The Japan Times reports that he began playing in his first year of elementary school, won tournaments, and earned his pro licence in April.Saiga NAK, a sports media outlet, says that he plays under the name "Yuki" for Tokyo Verdy eSports and has also won the elementary school division of the 2024 SAGA National Prefectural eSports Championship and the open division of a 2025 SHIGA championship.You use AI every day. articles.body: El regreso al césped para trabajar con el grupo de Aitor Ruibal, de manera parcial, ha sido la principal novedad en la segunda sesión de entrenamiento de la semana para el Betis, que los verdiblancos han llevado a cabo este miércoles en sus instalaciones de la Ciudad Deportiva Luis del Sol. El polivalente futbolista catalán no se ejercitaba con sus compañeros desde el pasado mes de mayo, antes de pasar por el quirófano para resolver una lesión de menisco externo. Ruibal necesitará aún algunas semanas más para estar disponible para Pellegrini, pero esta vuelta parcial al grupo supone sin duda un importante primer paso para dejar atrás su larga lesión y empezar poco a poco a entrar en la dinámica del equipo. Un día a día al que ha vuelto también Dani Ceballos esta mañana después de ausentarse ayer por gestión de cargas. El utrerano apunta a estar disponible en el amistoso de mañana frente al Ceuta. articles.title: Will Scotland head coach Sebastien Pocognoli change goalkeeper after Angus Gunn performance in Swiss loss?
articles.summary: Andy Burke ponders whether Scotland head coach Sebastien Pocognoli will change goalkeeper after Angus Gunn's performance in the 3-0 defeat by Switzerland.
articles.body:
If it was a bad night for Jack Hendry, whose 11th-minute red card precipitated Scotland's demise against Switzerland, then it was hardly an evening Angus Gunn will look back on with any great fondness either.

"I've never been a big defender of goalkeepers and I'm looking for more from Angus Gunn," was the view of Sportsound pundit Andy Halliday on the Scotland keeper's performance.

The San Jose Earthquakes stopper, 30, was arguably at fault for the first and third of the three goals that hit the back of his net as the Swiss coasted to victory at Hampden in a deeply unsatisfactory first home match under Sebastien Pocognoli.

The opening goal came in the immediate aftermath of Hendry's red card for denying Dan Ndoye a goalscoring opportunity. Scotland thought they had been given a reprieve as referee Nenad Minakovic's original award of a penalty was changed after a VAR review to a free-kick on the edge of the box.

The let-off meant little as Ricardo Rodriguez smashed the set-piece past Gunn on the goalkeeper's side to open the scoring.

"Shoulder height and not a lot of pace," was Halliday's view. "For me I think it's so poor from Angus Gunn."

After Nico Elvedi turned home Ndoye's cross to double the Swiss lead, Zeki Amdouni rifled a shot that went through Gunn's arms and high into the net to make it 3-0.

"I know it's a powerful strike, but that's one that Angus Gunn can keep out," said former Scotland forward James McFadden.

Gunn started all three games at the World Cup in front of Liam Kelly and Craig Gordon. It was testament to Gordon's extraordinary longevity that he made the squad for the finals at the age of 43 - but also highlighted the lack of other quality options competing for the number one jersey.

Falkirk's Scott Bain has replaced the retired Gordon in the squad for this Nations League campaign but there is a sense Scotland are not as blessed in the goalkeeping department as they have been in years gone by.

So, will Pocognoli be tempted to make a change in goals for the upcoming matches against North Macedonia on Saturday and Slovenia on Tuesday?

"I don't think there's somebody that's battering the door down to take his jersey because a lot of them aren't playing football," said Halliday.

"He probably is the number one deservedly but you never feel as confident with Angus Gunn between the sticks as you would have done a Craig Gordon, an Allan McGregor, a David Marshall, a Jim Leighton, an Andy Goram. They have been our goalies for the last 20-25 years.

"I'm looking at the first and the third goal - and I might be in the minority for the third goal, I think a lot of people will think it's been hit with such pace - but the goalies I mentioned there, do they save them? I think they do."

New coach, new players, but same old failings hamper Scotland

Hampden debut to forget but Pocognoli looks at bigger picture

Who 'battled impressively' for Scots? And how did you rate players?

Always disappointed when I concede - Gunn

Gunn made a couple of smart saves from Ndoye either side of half-time to prevent Switzerland killing the game off even earlier, but the keeper admitted he would look at the goals he conceded to see where he might have done better.

"They were good strikes but, as a goalkeeper, I'm always disappointed when I concede a goal," Gunn told media after the game.

"I'll look back and see what I could have done better and get better for the next game.

"[For the first goal] obviously when you've got a free-kick that close, you want to protect your side. I was holding as much as I could and saw it late. I'll probably look back at it.

"I'll probably be disappointed and try and get better for next time."

articles.title: Man City: Micah Richards 'devastated' after reading Premier League verdict on charges
articles.summary: Former Manchester City defender Micah Richards felt "absolutely devastated" after reading the Premier League's "damning" verdict on the club's financial charges.
articles.body:
Former Manchester City defender Micah Richards says he felt "absolutely devastated" after reading the Premier League's "damning" guilty verdict on the club's financial charges.

An independent commission found that City arranged "sham contracts" with a number of commercial partners as part of a scheme to disguise secret funding of more than £830m.

The league confirmed City have been found guilty of all charges related to breaches of financial rules between the 2009-10 and 2017-18 seasons, and all but one in relation to failure to co-operate with the investigation.

The club continue to deny any wrongdoing and have until 2 October to submit an appeal.

During that nine-year period the Sky Blues won the Premier League three times, with Richards part of their title-winning squad in 2011-12.

"The reports were troubling," he said on The Rest is Football podcast. "I saw the words which were used by the Premier League in 'sham contracts' and I felt absolutely devastated.

"I was at that club since I was 14 years old, I would die for that club. I achieved my dream at Manchester City , but then to hear these reports, and not only me as an ex-player, but the fans, what they have to go through, absolutely devastating."

While Richards was part of the City's youth academy he lived in 'digs' with a local family who are long-term supporters of the club.

The 38-year-old added: "My digs man, he rang me and he was literally in tears and asking me about information, which I don't know. I haven't got the answers to tell him.

"That's someone who's supported the club for 60-odd years and the uncertainty around it is just heartbreaking.

"To have a headline of this nature for a club that I love so much, it's been difficult. If you listen to the reports, they are damning.

"I feel saddened, I feel angry, I feel a little bit confused because, on the other side, you have City's side of the story."

City chairman Khaldoon Al Mubarak said in a statement on Saturday that the club is still confident of proving its innocence, while on Tuesday chief executive Ferran Soriano said in a video message , external to staff and players that "irrefutable evidence" had been "ignored" by the commission.

City owners are just gaslighting - Carragher

City won their second Premier League title in 2013-14, overtaking Liverpool during the run-in to finish two points above the Reds.

Former Liverpool defender Jamie Carragher, who retired in 2013, said: "I feel for the players... they'll almost feel like a lot of their career is going to have an asterisk, or a lot of people will be calling it a sham.

"The players were told everything was fine. What the [City] hierarchy are coming out with now, they're just gaslighting.

"I think the titles should be taken off their list. Whether other clubs get them is probably slightly different. City have not just hurt their own players."

The 2013-14 season was the closest that Carragher's long-time team-mate Steven Gerrard came to winning the Premier League title.

"Those players will never get that feeling and it was robbed by Man City," Carragher added on Sky Sports News.

"No-one remembers the medal. Giving trophies or medals back, it doesn't mean anything. It's not about medals, it's about feelings."

articles.title: Manchester City guilty of all financial breaches, Premier League confirms; expulsion threat looms
articles.summary: Manchester City have been found guilty of serious breaches of the Premier League’s financial rules over a nine-season period from 2009 to 2018, with an
articles.body: Manchester City have been found guilty of serious breaches of the Premier League’s financial rules over a nine-season period from 2009 to 2018, with an independent commission ruling that the club used commercial arrangements to inflate its revenues and reduce costs.The commission found that City arranged contracts with several commercial partners under which the companies paid only part of the agreed sponsorship fees. The remaining amounts were funded by Abu Dhabi United Group Investment and Development (ADUG), which owned the club.The commission also found that further arrangements funded by ADUG allowed City to record lower operating expenses than they actually incurred.According to the ruling, the arrangements artificially increased the club’s revenues and reduced its costs by more than £900 million ($1.2 billion) during the period under investigation. This meant City did not accurately report their income and expenditure under the Premier League and UEFA’s financial sustainability rules.The commission found that City would have breached spending limits "by a very substantial amount" if the club had reported its finances accurately.City were also found guilty on the majority of charges relating to their failure to cooperate with the Premier League’s investigation. The commission said the club had "made concerted efforts to stop and frustrate the Premier League" during the four-year investigation.No sanction has been imposed yet and City have said they will appeal the decision. Under Premier League rules, the punishment can range from a fine or points deduction to expulsion from the division.Everton and Nottingham Forest were handed points deductions during the 2023/24 season for single breaches of the financial sustainability rules. If a similar penalty were applied to City for more than 100 charges, the club could face relegation.The ruling puts City’s place in the Premier League at risk and also raises questions over whether titles could be stripped."The core decision establishes the facts of what happened at Manchester City during this period. It details how the club systematically broke Premier League rules for nearly a decade," Premier League chief executive Richard Masters said in a statement on Tuesday."Now we have the commission's decision, we are committed to moving swiftly through the remainder of the process, to provide certainty for the league, our clubs and fans."The decision follows an investigation into alleged breaches that began before the Premier League charged City with more than 100 offences in 2023. A hearing by an independent commission began in September 2024 and concluded three months later.Since Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed al-Nahyan, vice-president and deputy prime minister of the United Arab Emirates, took over the club in 2008, City have won eight Premier League titles, four FA Cups and seven League Cups. They also won the Champions League for the first time in 2023.City expressed "surprise" at the commission’s decision and said they would continue to challenge the findings."Manchester City FC will now pursue the appeal avenues open to it, on the basis that the opinion contains clear material errors, of law, principle and fact, and is unsafe," the club said in a statement."It's incredibly serious, the Premier League report is incredibly stark," said the British government's culture, media and sport secretary Lisa Nandy.Stay updated with the latest Asian Games 2026 news, check the Asian Games medal tally and complete Asian Games schedule.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.body: La Selección Española contará con una nueva incorporación en su concentración para afrontar los dos compromisos que todavía tiene por delante en esta ventana internacional de la UEFA Nations League. Fran García, jugador del Real Betis Balompié, se suma al grupo dirigido por el combinado nacional después de que Alejandro Grimaldo haya tenido que abandonar la convocatoria. El cambio llega después de que el defensa internacional del Club Atlético de Madrid sintiera unas molestias en el muslo izquierdo durante el calentamiento previo al encuentro que enfrentó a España y Croacia en el Sánchez-Pizjuán. El futbolista fue sometido posteriormente a las pruebas médicas correspondientes para conocer el alcance de la dolencia y valorar su continuidad con el equipo nacional. Tras los exámenes realizados, los servicios médicos han optado por que el jugador deje la concentración como medida preventiva. La decisión responde a la intención de evitar cualquier riesgo añadido y permitir que el futbolista pueda recuperarse de las molestias con las máximas garantías. De esta manera, Fran García, que suma dos partidos como internacional pero que no iba con La Roja desde octubre de 2023, pasa a formar parte de la convocatoria de España para completar la plantilla de cara a los dos partidos que aún restan en esta ventana de la Nations League, competición que levantó hace tres años. articles.title: Drawing of lots sends Oman through to Gulf Cup semi-finals at expense of Iraq
articles.summary: Oman edge into the semi-finals of the Gulf Cup but they do so in extraordinary fashion after they are picked ahead of Iraq in the drawing of lots.
articles.body:
Oman edged into the semi-finals of the Gulf Cup in extraordinary fashion after they were picked ahead of Iraq in the drawing of lots.

Oman's 3-1 win over Kuwait meant both the Omanis and Iraq finished level on four points in their group and, as they had identical records, lots were drawn to separate them and decide who would finish second and progress to the last four.

Organisers said the draw was the final tie-breaker after they had applied "the selection criteria stipulated in the regulations".

These included "head-to-head results, goal difference, number of goals, and disciplinary card points" with Oman and Iraq level "until the final criterion was reached".

With yellow cards included in the count-back categories, Oman's Musab Al-Shaqsy would have been ruing the booking he picked up against Kuwait.

After Al-Shaqsy scored his side's third goal late on in their win over Iraq he was yellow carded for taking his top off during his celebration.

And, with Oman and Iran, who were beaten 2-0 by Saudi Arabia in their final group game, level on everything else, it meant both countries also finished even on the disciplinary front.

That meant lots had to be drawn "in the presence of representatives of the concerned authorities" and, ultimately, Oman went through to the semi-finals.

Previous occasions when lots were needed

One of the most recent cases of a drawing of lots occurred at the Africa Cup of Nations in 2015.

On that occasion, Guinea progressed to the quarter-finals at the expense of Mali after both had finished level in their group.

At the 1990 World Cup in Italy, the Netherlands and the Republic of Ireland were tied in their group and, while both were guaranteed a place in the next round, lots were needed to determine who would qualify in second and who would qualify in third place.

The draw resulted in Ireland being awarded second place and a game against Romania, while the Dutch ended up third and faced eventual winners West Germany.

In 1970, lots were required during the World Cup to determine who out of the Soviet Union and Mexico would be named group winners of Group One. The Soviet Union ended up being deemed group winners.

Although it had not been needed since 1994 the drawing of lots remained as the final tie-breaker until the 2022 World Cup in Qatar, after which it was replaced by where the teams stand in the latest Fifa world rankings, which are updated after every international match.

articles.title: Asencio será operado: estará entre dos y cuatro meses de baja
articles.standfirst: El central pasará por el quirófano para solucionar la fisura en la tibia de la pierna derecha que arrastra desde la pasada temporada
articles.summary: El central pasará por el quirófano para solucionar la fisura en la tibia de la pierna derecha que arrastra desde la pasada temporada
articles.body: Raúl Asencio pasará por el quirófano para solucionar definitivamente la fractura en la tibia de la pierna derecha que arrastra desde principios de año. La decisión ya está tomada. El central será operado mañana y afrontará un largo proceso de recuperación, que será de entre dos y cuatro meses de baja. Ayer martes MARCA adelantaba que el central madridista había tenido que volver a parar por nuevas molestias en la zona y que se acercaba un poco más al quirófano. Sólo un día después, los malos presagios que había en Valdebebas se han cumplido y el defensa será intervenido. "Nuestro jugador Raúl Asencio será sometido mañana a una intervención quirúrgica a causa de una fractura por estrés en la tibia de la pierna derecha", informa el parte médico emitido hoy por el Real Madrid, confirmando la noticia de MARCA. Las molestias no han remitido en ningún momento y un nuevo episodio de dolor en la zona dañada ha sido el detonante definitivo para que se tome la decisión de que el jugador sea intervenido quirúrgicamente. La operación llevaba rondando a Asencio desde el final de la temporada pasada, cuando ya estuvo sobre la mesa esa opción, aprovechando el verano para amortiguar el largo tiempo de recuperación. Una baja que rondará los 2-4 meses, lo que llevará al jugador a estar fuera de combate hasta principios de año, aproximadamente. El problema venía de lejos. La lesión en la tibia ya condicionó a Asencio en el segundo tramo de la pasada temporada, cuando las lesiones golpeaban con especial dureza a la plantilla del Real Madrid. En aquel momento, Asencio decidió no parar. El equipo necesitaba centrales y él dio un paso adelante pese a que el riesgo era evidente. "No paro ahora ni loco", llegó a decir cuando se le planteó la posibilidad de detenerse. Una decisión tan valiente como arriesgada, porque el jugador se jugó el físico en un momento en el que el equipo atravesaba una situación límite. La solución entonces fue buscar una vía intermedia que le permitiera seguir compitiendo. Asencio recibió un tratamiento mínimamente invasivo destinado a retirar células anómalas en la zona de la cicatriz de la tibia, donde se había formado un callo mal consolidado. La consolidación no era la adecuada y podía terminar debilitando el hueso hasta convertir la fisura en una fractura. El cuerpo médico apostó entonces por un tratamiento que permitiera ganar tiempo y evitar una operación inmediata. Asencio pudo seguir ayudando al equipo, pero muy limitado y condicionado por el dolor. Con el final de la temporada llegó el momento de descansar. Los servicios médicos descartaron la operación y el plan durante el verano se limitó a reposo, recuperación y dejar que el paso del tiempo permitiera a la zona regenerarse. La previsión era que la tibia respondiera al descanso después de meses de exigencia. Pero no ha ocurrido así. La situación de Asencio ha ido empeorando y la tibia volvió a convertirse en una amenaza para su temporada. articles.title: Republic of Ireland will fulfil second Israel fixture, says head coach Heimir Hallgrimsson
articles.summary: Republic of Ireland head coach Heimir Hallgrimsson says the team's second Uefa Nations League game against Israel will go ahead as planned.
articles.body:
Republic of Ireland head coach Heimir Hallgrimsson says the team's second Uefa Nations League game against Israel will go ahead as planned.

Hallgrimsson's side beat Israel 3-0 in Hungary on Sunday after the Republic of Ireland players voted to fulfil the fixture.

They have faced calls to withdraw from the games because of the ongoing Israel-Gaza war, with the 'Stop The Game' campaign - organised by the pressure group Irish Sport for Palestine - issuing an open letter this week calling for the Republic of Ireland to pull out of Sunday's behind-closed-doors match in Serbia.

However, speaking before Thursday's game against Austria in Dublin, Hallgrimsson said the Republic of Ireland will fulfil the second Israel fixture and that he is not aware of a squad meeting to decide whether to play the game.

"The FAI (Football Association of Ireland) has said we are playing both games. That was our intention when we came into the camp and it is still our intention," said Hallgrimsson.

"We are trying to focus on the football. It is already decided we will fulfil the games."

On Saturday, doubts emerged over whether the first Israel game would take place after the Republic of Ireland's pre-match news conference was postponed because of a squad meeting.

When the news conference commenced more than five hours later than planned, FAI chief executive David Courell said a players' vote on whether to play the game passed by a "significant majority".

While fulfilling the game, the Republic of Ireland players did not engage in pre-match formalities , wore black armbands and bowed their heads during Israel's national anthem.

The Republic of Ireland's most recent home game - a friendly against Qatar in May - was interrupted when fans threw tennis balls featuring the Palestine flag on to the pitch.

When asked about potential protests during Thursday's encounter with Austria, Hallgrimsson said: "I must focus on football. I will let others think about security and those things.

"We are playing Austria, the highest-ranked team in the group. I'm not going to allow outside noise to affect me focusing on football."

FAI unclear over possible sanctions if game not played

Republic of Ireland 'raised awareness worldwide' in Israel game - Hallgrimsson

On Saturday, goalkeeper Gavin Bazunu made himself unavailable for both Israel games, saying he felt it "would be wrong to participate".

With Bazunu having returned to training before the Austria match, Hallgrimsson praised the Bolton player and the rest of his squad while hitting out at "lies" that had been reported regarding the goalkeeper's decision.

"Gavin is a great lad. I've always had a good relationship with him and it's probably more tough for him than the other players, but they have really welcomed him," said Hallgrimsson, who confirmed Luton keeper Josh Keeley will take Bazunu's place in the squad for the second Israel game.

"There's been a lot of lies said around all of this, but we welcome him back and he's taken part, amazing.

"I think it shows his character, as well, to be with us, so I want to give him praise for that. I want to give the players praise for how welcome they have been with him.

"Life goes on. He is a part of this group and I think that shows how strong the bond is between these players that even a thing like this is not breaking us."

Hallgrimsson also praised midfielder Finn Azaz, but would not confirm whether he will be selected for the second Israel game after he was an unused substitute in Sunday's 3-0 win.

The Southampton midfielder has family links to Israel on his mother's side, with Hallgrimsson lauding the 26-year-old's "incredible emotional control".

"He's been one of the persons I admire the most in how he conducted himself in all of this," said Hallgrimsson.

"It is about being a member of a team, so you need to listen to all opinions. To do your thing, to do your work with grace and understanding of all opinions.

"Talking about walking the extra mile to being a part of a national team, I don't have words to explain to you and you wouldn't understand because inside camp he has so much respect within this group of players."

articles.title: Consortium including Alexandre Pato completes Northampton Town takeover
articles.summary: The takeover of Northampton Town by a consortium including former AC Milan and Brazil forward Alexandre Pato has been completed.
articles.body:
The takeover of Northampton Town by a consortium including former AC Milan, Chelsea and Brazil forward Alexandre Pato has been completed.

Sports Alpha Capital (SAC) had their proposed deal with the Cobblers approved by the Independent Football Regulator (IFR) and English Football League (EFL) earlier this month.

SAC will take a 70% shareholding in Northampton Town Ventures Limited (NTVL) - the company which owns the majority of shares in the League Two club.

Existing owners David Bower, Nigel Le Quesne and Kelvin Thomas will collectively retain a 30% shareholding.

Northampton confirmed the deal would leave them debt-free after announcing a pre-tax loss of just under £3m in April 2026.

The takeover will see Thomas step down as chairman after more than a decade in the role, though he - along with Bower and Le Quesne - will remain as shareholders and directors.

Thomas - who headed the takeover of the Cobblers when they faced a winding-up petition in 2015 - said it had been "an enormous privilege" to lead the club.

SAC's Joao Xavier and Tim Chamberlain will become co-chairmen, with Pato set to join the board as a director.

Chief executive officer James Whiting and supporters' representative Tom Cliffe will also remain on the board, but Jim Rosenthal and Mike Wailing will step down from the board and become associate directors.

In a joint statement, Xavier and Chamberlain said they were "extremely proud to become custodians of a club with such a rich history, passionate supporter base and important place within its community".

"We have ambitious plans for Northampton Town, but ambition must go hand in hand with sustainability and an understanding of what the club means to the people of Northampton and Northamptonshire," the statement added.

"We want the club to continue to be a source of pride within its community and will work closely with the Community Trust, supporters, staff, partners and local stakeholders to ensure that relationship continues to grow.

"We are looking forward to spending much more time in Northampton, listening to supporters and working together to help the club realise its potential both on and off the pitch.

"This is the beginning of a long-term commitment from Sports Alpha Capital to Northampton Town Football Club, and we are incredibly excited about the journey ahead."

Xavier and Chamberlain said that further details of their vision for the club would follow.

Pato was named by SAC , external as one of its investors, along with Gemcorp Capital, a London-based independent investment management firm.

The 37-year-old retired from playing last year. He is best known for his five-and-a-half-year spell at AC Milan where he scored 63 goals in 150 matches and won the Serie A title in 2010-11.

Sports Alpha Capital was previously in discussions about taking over Colchester United earlier this year but decided to pull out of a potential deal following initial talks.

The Cobblers suffered relegation to the fourth tier last season, finishing bottom of the League One table, and appointed Chris Hogg as their manager in May.

They brought in 13 players during the summer transfer window, including striker Matty Warhurst from Manchester City.

articles.title: Danjuma, un año sin marcar en Primera tras 40 remates: sólo anotó ante un equipo... ¡de regional en Copa!
articles.standfirst: Se cumplen hoy 365 días sin celebrar un gol en la élite tras la maldición del penalti que erró contra Aarón Escandell en el Valencia-Oviedo de Mestalla siendo su principio del fin anotador
articles.summary: Se cumplen hoy 365 días sin celebrar un gol en la élite tras la maldición del penalti que erró contra Aarón Escandell en el Valencia-Oviedo de Mestalla siendo su principio del fin anotador
articles.body: Arnaut Danjuma está de aniversario... pero uno de esos que mejor sería que pasara de puntillas. Lo que ocurre es que un año sin marcar un gol en la élite deja poso. Demasiado en una profesión tan vigilada mediáticamente. Y sí... Danjuma suma este miércoles, 30 de septiembre, 365 días justos sin haber podido celebrar un sólo gol de los 'grandes'. Ante equipos de la élite. El último meta al que le pudo marcar fue a Aarón Escandell en aquel encuentro que acabó con victoria ovetense (1-2) en Mestalla y que fue el principio de la debacle del equipo. El holandés, con 1-0 a favor de los locales, pudo hacer el segundo, pero falló desde el punto de penalti y después el equipo azulón logró la remontada. Ahora bien, lo único positivo que puede sacar el extremo de 29 años es que sí ha podido anotar en los últimos 365 días. Fue ante un equipo de fútbol regional. Ante el Maracena en Copa del Rey jugado en octubre pasado. Pero la sequía es la nota que ha predominado en la historia de Danjuma a lo largo de este último año. Aquel penalti errado fue como una especie de maldición. Ya no ha marcado en un partido 'serio'. En uno de Primera división. Danjuma ha tenido oportunidades de hacer goles a lo largo de este ejercicio, pero la fortuna no le ha acompañado ni tampoco el acierto personal del ariete. Desde aquel partido ante el Oviedo empezó su particular travesía por el desierto. Porque remató en 24 ocasiones en las 32 jornadas restantes, mientras que en la actual lleva ya 16 remates sin fortuna. O sea, que ya acumula 40 tiros y no ha tenido una sola recompensa.

articles.title: Real Madrid new signing continues to strengthen claim to replace Vinicius in Mourinho’s XI
articles.summary: Yan Diomande’s international break has given Real Madrid another glimpse of the qualities that convinced the club to sign him, while simultaneously raising a...
articles.body:
Yan Diomande 's international break has given Real Madrid another glimpse of the qualities that convinced the club to sign him, while simultaneously raising an increasingly difficult question for Jose Mourinho.

The 19-year-old has continued to impress with Ivory Coast , producing strong performances against both Somalia and Ghana .

Notably, his displays have inevitably brought the debate over Real Madrid's left wing back into focus, particularly with Vinicius Jr. struggling to reproduce his best form.

Both players prefer the same position. Their natural role is on the left side of the attack, although Diomande is capable of playing on the right as well.

That creates an intriguing situation for Mourinho, as Vinicius has been one of Real Madrid's most important players for several years but is struggling for form this season .

Diomande, meanwhile, is only beginning his career at the Santiago Bernabeu but is showing that he is not afraid to demand attention.

The question is therefore becoming harder to ignore: could Diomande eventually force Mourinho to rethink his first-choice left winger?

Diomande continues to impress with Ivory Coast

Diomande's latest performances have been particularly encouraging because they have shown different aspects of his game.

Against Somalia, the Real Madrid youngster completed five of the six dribbles he attempted, registered three shots and created three more shooting opportunities for his teammates.

He did not score or provide an assist, but that does not tell the full story of his performance.

Ivory Coast faced a deep defensive block, which can make life difficult for a winger who relies on space to attack. Diomande still found ways to influence the game.

When the wing was closed, he moved inside. When defenders gave him room, he attacked them directly.

His willingness to always be available for a pass and immediately try to create an advantage meant that his involvement improved Ivory Coast's attacking situations.

Certainly, the quality of the opposition should obviously be taken into consideration, as Somalia are not among the strongest sides Ivory Coast can face.

However, their defensive approach did create a different challenge for Diomande, who had to find solutions against a compact team rather than simply exploit large spaces, which is why his performance still deserves recognition.

More importantly for Real Madrid, Diomande showed the confidence to keep asking questions of the opposition.

Diomande produced a statement performance vs Ghana

Before the Somalia clash, the winger's performance against Ghana provided an even stronger indication of his development.

Even against a considerably more demanding opponent, the 19-year-old ran the show for long periods and produced numbers that highlighted his involvement.

Diomande completed seven dribbles, won 10 duels and created three chances. He also recorded 76 touches and completed 91% of his passes.

Simply put, there is efficiency behind the flair.

Ivory Coast deployed Diomande primarily from the right against Ghana rather than in his preferred position on the left, although the change of flank did little to restrict his influence.

He repeatedly drove at Ghana's defence and even produced an elastico during the second half, providing another example of the confidence he has shown throughout the international break.

Considering this development, it is here that the situation becomes particularly interesting for Vinicius.

There is no question about the Brazil ian's achievements. He has established himself as a world-class player through years of performances for Real Madrid and has played a central role in the club's biggest victories.

However, his current form has not reached those same heights.

Unfortunately, this season, the issue is not one poor performance , as Vinicius has struggled to produce the consistency that has previously made him so dangerous, and similar concerns have followed him with Brazil, making Diomande's emergence more noticeable.

Vinicius Jr. is struggling for form this season. (Photo by Albert Perez/Getty Images)

The Ivorian does not appear to need an extended period of hesitation before trying to make things happen.

He receives the ball, attacks defenders and looks for ways to create an advantage, creating a very unfamiliar competition for Vinicius, something that he never encountered at the club.

Mourinho faces a difficult decision at Real Madrid

The debate should not be interpreted as proof that Diomande has already surpassed Vinicius.

For what it is worth, the Brazilian has a far greater body of work at the elite level and has earned the trust that comes with years of outstanding performances, but football moves and it moves quickly.

If Vinicius continues to struggle while Diomande maintains the level of confidence and effectiveness he has displayed with Ivory Coast, Mourinho could eventually face a difficult selection call.

The Real Madrid manager has the authority to make that decision, and one of the reasons his appointment generated so much interest was the expectation that he would not avoid uncomfortable choices.

For now, there is no indication that Vinicius is about to lose his starting position.

Diomande still has to translate his international form into regular club performances and adapt fully to the demands of Real Madrid.

articles.body: Hamza está viviendo un 2026 de ensueño. A la larga lista de logros que ha acumulado a lo largo de este año se suma ahora uno especialmente significativo con su selección: su primer gol con la absoluta de Egipto. El delantero azulgrana estrenó su cuenta realizadora con el combinado nacional ayer martes contra Sudán, apenas dos semanas después de haber firmado su renovación con el Barcelona. Un nuevo capítulo en un año que está consolidando al joven atacante como uno de los nombres propios del fútbol egipcio. El tanto llegó además de forma prácticamente inmediata. Hamza saltó al terreno de juego en el minuto 87, sustituyendo a Omar Marmoush, y apenas cinco después encontró el camino del gol para celebrar su primera diana con la selección absoluta. Hasta ahora, Hamza había disputado algunos minutos en el Mundial del pasado verano, pero se le resistía el gol. No había conseguido marcar ni en partidos oficiales ni en encuentros amistosos. Con esta diana, Hamza se convierte en el tercer jugador más joven de la historia de la selección egipcia en marcar con la absoluta. Por delante están únicamente Abdel Karim Sakr, que lo hizo con 17 años, 8 meses y 28 días, y Ahmed Hossam Mido, antiguo delantero del Ajax y del Tottenham. Además, el gol contra Sudán le permite cerrar un mes de septiembre que no olvidará. El pasado día 11, el Barcelona anunciaba la renovación del delantero y el 15, el atacante firmaba su nuevo contrato junto a Joan Laporta y atendía a los medios de comunicación. El 2026 continúa dejando grandes noticias para Hamza. Tras seguir creciendo en el Barcelona, consolidarse en dinámica del primer equipo, renovar y ganar peso con la selección, el delantero ha añadido ahora un nuevo hito a su trayectoria: marcar por primera vez con la camiseta de Egipto.

articles.title: Fantasy football injury report: Latest Week 4 updates on key players
articles.summary: Panthers WR Jalen Coker has been one of fantasy's most pleasant surprises, but he's dealing with a quad strain. Get updates on his and others' injuries here.
articles.body:
Depth is starting to become a critical issue for fantasy football managers. And we're only in Week 4!

After a rash of quarterback injuries earlier in the season, several standout running backs went down last week. The normally reliable De'Von Achane (knee) is now out for the season, and Travis Etienne is set to miss some time with a hamstring injury. Fantasy managers will need to find replacements, while also dealing with other various ailments elsewhere.

Here are some of the most prominent players dealing with nagging ailments or coming back from major issues that will impact fantasy managers most in Week 4. As always, keep an eye on the latest developments leading up to kickoff with our player notes page .

25 best fantasy football wide receiver PPR seasons since 2001

The last of the big three running back injuries from Week 3 appears to be the least serious. Hall exited early with a thigh injury, but he still may have a chance to play on Sunday. The Jets have classified him as week-to-week after an MRI determined the injury wasn't serious enough for him to go on IR. Braelon Allen will likely take over Hall's duties as the lead back on Sunday in Chicago .

Speaking of the Bears, third-stringer Case Keenum was outstanding in a Monday night romp over the Eagles. But he was only playing because Bagent missed practice time during the week with concussion symptoms. Do the Bears mess with a good thing and go back to Bagent vs. the Jets? Health is not the issue here since Bagent was cleared late last week to serve as the backup.

One of the NFL's most pleasant early-season surprises, Coker has been the fantasy WR9 through the first three weeks. However, he left Sunday's game against the Browns with a quad strain − after initially beling listed as questionable due to a sore ankle. Monitor his practice activity, but he should be available to face the Lions this week.

Wright was inactive last week with a foot injury and a neck stinger he suffered in Week 2. That was before Achane went down and Ollie Gordon had to take over lead back duties. He's still "day-to-day," according to coach Jeff Hafley, but with a week to recover, Wright figures to be in the mix on Sunday as the Dolphins travel to Minnesota .

Nacua was expected to miss a couple games with his lingering hip injury. Now that he has, the Rams are hopeful he can return to face the Eagles on Sunday. Coach Sean McVay said on Monday that Nacua's status is still "to be determined," which isn't the optimistic tone fantasy managers want to hear. Stay tuned.

Jefferson missed the entire second half of Week 3's game with an ankle sprain, though coach Kevin O'Connell did say he considered putting his star wideout back in the game at several points. The injury doesn't look like a long-term concern after an MRI on Monday came back clean.

A rib issue forced Evans to leave Sunday's win over the Cardinals early, but tests showed no major issues. That's good news for fantasy managers, but even better news for the Niners, who have seen their receiving corps decimated by injuries. He'll suit up this week if at all possible.

Goedert didn't practice all last week after injuring his knee in Week 2. The injury was concerning enough that the Eagles went out and signed free agent TE Zach Ertz and put him on the field right away. MCL sprains don't just go away, so consider Goedert questionable for the Rams on Sunday.

Collins is dealing with a hamstring strain that has kept him from even getting on the practice field for the past two weeks. With the Texans off to an 0-3 start, there may be extra incentive to get Collins ready for this week's showdown with the Cowboys.

articles.title: Zidane deja huella desde el principio: "Aún conserva esa técnica, en su época debió de ser increíble"
articles.standfirst: Koné reconoce que los jugadores de la selección de Francia están encantados en estos primeros días de la 'era Zinedine'
articles.summary: Koné reconoce que los jugadores de la selección de Francia están encantados en estos primeros días de la 'era Zinedine'
articles.body: "Es un placer tener de entrenador a Zidane, una leyenda mundial", dice Koné. Zinedine ya está dejando huella en los jugadores de la selección de Francia. Es la primera concentración del técnico al frente de Les Bleus y los futbolistas están impresionados con su capacidad para dirigir al equipo y con su calidad, ese toque y control de balón que no ha perdido a pesar de haber colgado las botas mucho tiempo atrás. "Lo que más me sorprendió fue su dominio técnico en los entrenamientos. No ha perdido nada de su técnica, y verlo en directo es aún mejor. Yo era pequeño cuando él estaba al final de su carrera y debió de ser increíble en su época. Personalmente, escucho todo lo que me dice. Él era centrocampista y sólo puedo aprender de él. Me da muchos consejos sobre posicionamiento, sobre el equilibrio del equipo, me asigna responsabilidades y tengo que cumplirlas", explicaba Koné en su comparecencia ante los medios. Zinedine está cumpliendo su sueño. "Me dije que la única cosa que quería hacer después del Real Madrid era esto", reconocía el míster, que esperó pacientemente a que se terminara la 'era Deschamps' para tener su oportunidad. Zidane ha empezado con buen pie al frente de Les Bleus. Francia ha ganado los dos partidos en los que ha estado en el banquillo. Firma un pleno: seis puntos de seis posibles. La dos victorias han sido por la mínima. En el debut se impuso (0-1) a Turquía, el día que se lesionó Mbappé, que fue el autor del gol, y después derrotó a Bélgica, gracias a una acción espectacular de Olise. El impacto del entrenador ha sido inmediato. "Nos dirige de una manera muy humana y sincera. Está muy cerca de los jugadores, hablando con nosotros en privado o delante del grupo. Es muy intuitivo. Nos da confianza y libertad, es genial, y estamos jugando nuestro juego natural. A nivel personal, ha sido sincero. Ha hablado con nosotros individualmente y a mí me ha dicho que juegue como suelo hacerlo, que toque con libertad", asegura Koné. Zidane, por su parte, esté satisfecho con lo que está viendo en estos primeros encuentros al frente de Francia. "Al final del partido contra Bélgica, nos dijo que estaba muy orgulloso de nosotros. Nos dijo que, en su opinión, éramos muy buenos jugadores. Tenemos facilidad para adaptarnos a sus peticiones", termina Koné.

articles.title: Which changes Italy could make for France after encouraging 4-1 Turkiye victory
articles.summary: A 4-1 victory away against Turkiye gave Italy and returning head coach Roberto Mancini a much needed confidence boost at the beginning of this week, but the...
articles.body:
A 4-1 victory away against Turkiye gave Italy and returning head coach Roberto Mancini a much needed confidence boost at the beginning of this week, but the CT is already weighing up his potential selections ahead of another difficult test away against France on Friday evening. Here is a look at the potential personnel changes that the Azzurri could make.

Which changes could Mancini make for France vs. Italy?

Mancini's second spell as head coach of the Italy national team got underway with a disappointing 2-0 defeat at home against Belgium last week, but a changed Azzurri side overcame Vincenzo Montella's Turkiye 4-1 thanks to goals from Alessandro Bastoni , Davide Frattesi , Michael Kayode and Francesco Pio Esposito on Monday night.

BURSA, TURKEY – SEPTEMBER 28: Michael Kayode of Italy celebrates scoring his team's third goal with teammate Sandro Tonali during the UEFA Nations League 2026/27 group phase match between Türkiye and Italy at Atatürk Spor Kompleksi Matli Stadyumu on September 28, 2026 in Bursa, Turkey. (Photo by Ahmad Mora/Getty Images)

For the Turkiye game, Mancini lined up in a 4-3-3 with debutant Kayode at right-back, Aston Villa man Matteo Ruggeri on the opposite side of full-back with Inter's Alessandro Bastoni and Atalanta 's Giorgio Scalvini at centre-back.

Sandro Tonali controlled the midfield department, which also included Frattesi and Nicolo Fagioli, behind a front three containing Giacomo Raspadori and the Esposito brothers (Pio and Sebastiano).

Given that the upcoming match against France will be Italy's third within the space of a week, it is unlikely that Mancini will stick with exactly the same starting line-up from the Turkiye victory.

According to reports from Sky Sport Italia , Kayode is one of the players hoping to keep hold of their starting spots after his impressive debut on Monday night. Captain and goalkeeper Gianluigi Donnarumma is also expected to remain in the starting XI.

Sky claims that Riccardo Calafiori , who started against Belgium but was rested against Turkiye, and Gianluca Mancini , who also started against Belgium, are the defenders most likely to return to the starting line-up against France.

There could be several alterations in midfield and attack as well: Sandro Tonali has started the last two matches and might be given a rest ahead of what would be his third match in seven days. Nicolo Barella is likely to return to the side if the Tottenham man drops out. The in-form Frattesi is hoping to keep hold of his starting spot.

ROME, ITALY – SEPTEMBER 25: Moise Kean of Italy in action during the UEFA Nations League 2026/27 group phase match between Italy and Belgium at Stadio Olimpico on September 25, 2026 in Rome, Italy. (Photo by Marco Rosi/Getty Images)

It is a similar situation at centre-forward for Pio Esposito, who has started in the last two matches and could come out of the starting line-up and provide an opportunity for Moise Kean instead.

There will be an enforced change on the wings as Raspadori has withdrawn from the squad following his involvement in the Turkiye match.

Mancini still has plenty of options in attacking areas, and Sky claims that any two of Sebastiano Esposito, Mohamed Ali Zoma, Nicolo Cambiaghi, Samuele Inacio or Antonio Vergara could be selected to start against France.

Indiana football has managed to maintain its two excellent coordinators, Mike Shanahan on offense and Bryant Haines on defense, through the first three seasons of Curt Cignetti's coaching tenure in Bloomington. Everyone knows that can't really last though.

After recovering from a knee injury, Ebnoutalib has enjoyed a remarkable start to the season with Eintracht Frankfurt, scoring five goals and providing two assists in five games.

Ebnoutalib's admirers will now be keen to see whether the 23-year-old can maintain his impressive form before deciding whether to step up their interest in the future.

articles.title: 🚨 BREAKING: Pep Guardiola breaks his silence after Man City verdict
articles.summary: Pep Guardiola has broken his silence after Manchester City were found guilty of serious breaches of the Premier League’s financial rules, with the former Cit...
articles.body:
Pep Guardiola has broken his silence after Manchester City were found guilty of serious breaches of the Premier League's financial rules, with the former City boss insisting he remains fully behind the club.

Guardiola, who left City at the end of last season after 10 years in charge, posted on social media: "I want every single Man City fan to know I am here; more than ever.

"I am, always have been, always will be, behind my club, my owner, my chairman, Ferran , the players, staff, Enzo and you, our unique supporters. Let me be clear: we will get through this together. I love you all."

The Premier League announced on Tuesday that an independent commission had found City guilty of all charges relating to serious financial breaches over a nine-season period between 2009/10 and 2017/18, as well as the majority of charges relating to the club's failure to cooperate with the league's investigation.

The charges, brought in February 2023 after a four-year investigation, covered allegations including providing inaccurate financial information, failing to properly report player and manager payments, breaching financial regulations and failing to cooperate with the Premier League. The commission also found that City used contracts which misrepresented agreements with commercial partners, artificially inflating revenues and reducing costs by more than £900 million during the period under investigation.

City have consistently denied wrongdoing and said the Premier League process remains ongoing. The club is expected to appeal the findings.

Guardiola's tenure overlapped with the final two seasons covered by the financial allegations, although there has been no suggestion that he was aware of any wrongdoing. He repeatedly defended City during the investigation, and in May, shortly before his departure, said he trusted the club's hierarchy and believed they had behaved correctly

articles.title: Pep Guardiola breaks silence on Man City’s guilty verdict
articles.summary: Guardiola has given his backing to the owners and the board after the club were found guilty of overstating their income by over £830m across eight seasons
articles.body:
Pep Guardiola has broken his silence after Manchester City were found guilty of the majority of the 115 charges against them, reiterating his backing of the owners and the board.

An independent commission, which was appointed following a four-year investigation to rule over the charges which stretch between 2009 and 2018, ruled that the current Premier League leaders had "sham contracts" arranged for a number of its commercial partners, finding that their income over eight seasons was "hugely overstated by over £830m".

The club vehemently deny the breaches with chief executive Ferran Soriano branding the process a " Premier League conspiracy theory" in a message to players and staff, while City have confirmed they will appeal against the ruling. They have until Friday 2 October to do so.

Guardiola has now responded to the verdict by stating that he is and "always will" be behind the club.

"I want every single Manchester City fan across the world to know I am here; more than ever," he wrote on Instagram.

"I am, always have been, always will, be behind my club, my owner, my chairman, Ferran, the players, staff, Enzo and you, our unique supporters.

"Let me be clear: we will get through this together. I love you all."
